name: Head Agent
description: Reads what every squad produced, decides what matters, and messages you the briefing on Telegram.
scheduledTask: Pull everything the squads produced since your last run, work out what actually matters, write the briefing, and send it to Telegram.
examples: What did the squads do overnight?
What should I focus on this week?
Summarise the last seven days and tell me what changed

settings.label: When should it message you?
settings.help: Your local time. The briefing lands in your Telegram at this hour every day.

settings.label: What are you building?
settings.placeholder: A scheduling tool for dental clinics. ICP: practice owners with 2-10 chairs.
settings.help: The head agent judges every squad's output against this. Be specific about who your customer is.

settings.label: What matters most right now?
settings.help: Decides what gets the top of your briefing when everything happened at once.

secrets.label: Model API key
secrets.help: OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter or Groq. You pay them directly.

secrets.label: Telegram bot token
secrets.help: Message @BotFather, send /newbot, paste the token here.

secrets.label: Telegram chat ID
secrets.help: Message your bot once, then open api.telegram.org/bot<TOKEN>/getUpdates and copy chat.id.

secrets.label: Squad data endpoint
secrets.help: Filled in automatically. Where it reads your other agents' output.
